items.text: 12 years in instructional design and online learning at community colleges and universities.
Led a team of four instructional designers.
Built a prompt library for first-draft course outlines, reviewed by a designer before use.
Wrote standing instructions so an AI assistant reports missing sources instead of inventing them.
Prototype course-QA checklist assistant (not in production).
Course review checklist cut average review rounds from 3 to 2 across 40 courses.
Accessibility remediation brought 120 course pages to the institution's standard in one term.
Canvas, Moodle, Kaltura, Power BI, Microsoft 365.
